text: {"danger_level":"orange","danger_reason":"The area is under a city-wide alert with underground shelter within a short walk based on a city-wide alert.","main_move":"GO_DOWN_INSIDE","main_move_text":"Go down to underground shelter","where_to_go":"Go ENE to Times shelter via ペンギン通り, which is 120 meters away and takes about 1.6 minutes walking.","do_now":[{"text":"Immediately stop outdoor activities and proceed to the nearest shelter such as basements or underground car parks.","advice_ids":["ar.stop_outdoor","ar.shelter_types"]},{"text":"Avoid using phones to keep communication lines free for emergencies after the siren sounds.","advice_ids":["ar.no_phones"]},{"text":"Report any unfamiliar activity and do not enter restricted areas.","advice_ids":["ar.report","ar.restricted"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not stay outdoors, show lights, or gather at windows.","advice_ids":["ar.stop_outdoor"]},{"text":"Do not photograph or share pictures online.","advice_ids":["ar.no_photos"]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"at home","text":"Install thick curtains or blinds on windows and do not use light visible from outside.","advice_ids":["ar.blackout_curtains","ar.lights_off"]},{"situation":"in a vehicle","text":"Do not enter restricted areas or use lights visible from outside.","advice_ids":["ar.restricted","ar.lights_off"]}],"call":["110 - Police","119 - Fire and ambulance"],"confidence":"medium","confidence_reason":"Medium confidence because there are two data gaps concerning unmapped basements and hospital status verification.","unknowns":["Basements are rarely mapped; a building basement near you may not appear here.","Hospitals shown are mapped major hospitals (emergency tag or large campus); their emergency services, capacity and current status are not verified.","An air-raid alert covers the whole city; SafeGround cannot predict where a strike may fall. It only measures how far people are from underground shelter.","Basements are rarely mapped; 'no shelter found' can mean 'not mapped', not 'none exists'.","Official guidance text is from a press report of a Delhi Government document; the original notice was not available to us."],"valid_while":[]}
